title: Walsh-spectrum classification of even-dimensional quadratic APN functions
summary: Classify all amplitude distributions realizable by quadratic APN functions in every even dimension.

formal_statement.body: For every even $n$, classify the amplitude distributions, equivalently the extended Walsh spectra, realizable by quadratic APN functions $F:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2^n$. Give necessary and sufficient conditions that decide whether any proposed amplitude distribution in the sense of Definition I.3 is realized by such a function.

scope.domain: Quadratic APN functions and extended Walsh spectra
assumptions: F : F_2^n -> F_2^n is quadratic and APN
Amplitude distributions use Definition I.3 of the source
scope.unresolved_remainder: A necessary-and-sufficient classification is still required for every realizable amplitude distribution in every even dimension; low-dimensional lists and necessary constraints do not settle the full classification.

citations.label: Beneteau--Goluboff--Kolsch--Vaghasiya, Walsh spectra of quadratic APN functions
citations.locator: Definition I.3 and discussion after Example I.4, pp. 5207-5208

progress.summary: The source derives new necessary conditions but states that the even-dimensional amplitude-distribution problem remains wide open.
citation_labels: Beneteau--Goluboff--Kolsch--Vaghasiya, Walsh spectra of quadratic APN functions
